description: This Java class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named LoanDelinquencyActionData for representing delinquency action details related to a loan. It encapsulates properties such as action type, start and end dates, creator and modifier IDs, and timestamps. The class provides a constructor that initializes these fields from a LoanDelinquencyAction domain object.

classes.name: LoanDelinquencyActionData
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for transferring delinquency action data associated with a loan, including action type, relevant dates, creator/modifier IDs, and timestamps.

methods.name: LoanDelinquencyActionData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DTO fields from a LoanDelinquencyAction domain object, extracting relevant properties and handling optional creator/modifier IDs.
